final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor narrowed the position to one the admissible record can support, not because any new evidence was introduced. The admissible evidence supports general deployment readiness at an aggregate level and shows no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows an unresolved below-target municipal permitting weakness and an incomplete draft mitigation artifact. Under the policy text, that combination does not support certification without material caveats. It does support a narrower position: certification only if the municipal permitting limitation is explicitly disclosed, with monitoring treated as a deployment control rather than as a substitute for the policy predicates. That is enough for compliant_with_caveats because the Actor no longer claims caveat-free compliance. The remaining concern is implementation evidence: the current record still does not show that the final model card actually contains the required disclosure or that approved risk acceptance exists.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the final model card has actually been updated to disclose the municipal permitting limitation.
The municipal permitting assistant slice remains below target for a named launch use case, concentrated in zoning exception explanation.
The draft mitigation runbook is still incomplete because the accountable owner and alert threshold are TBD, so it does not satisfy the policy path for eliminating the disclosure requirement.
The record still does not support any statement that there are no known material limitations or that certification is caveat-free.
